subject: Geography
central_question: How do geographical controls and atmospheric circulation create India’s monsoon climate, seasonal rhythm and regional diversity?
in_scope_units: Weather, climate and unity and diversity of monsoon climate.
Nature, onset and breaks of the monsoon.
Four meteorological seasons and their weather.
Monsoon branches, retreating monsoon and cyclones.
Rainfall distribution, economic importance and global warming.
banned_topics: Detailed forest classification, which belongs to Natural Vegetation.
Detailed drainage basins, which belong to Drainage System.
Plate tectonics, which belongs to Distribution of Oceans and Continents.

known_pitfalls.claim: Weather and climate mean the same.
known_pitfalls.correction: Weather is momentary; climate is the average over a long period.

known_pitfalls.claim: All India receives most rainfall in June–September.
known_pitfalls.correction: Tamil Nadu receives important rain in the retreating and northeast monsoon season.
They block cold winds and force monsoon winds to shed moisture.

known_pitfalls.claim: A monsoon break means the rainy season has ended.
known_pitfalls.correction: It is a dry spell within the southwest monsoon season.

known_pitfalls.claim: Both sides of the Western Ghats receive equal rain.
known_pitfalls.correction: The windward side is wet and the leeward side lies in rain shadow.

recommended_example_progression: Use Exercise 2(i) to define the ITCZ.
Use Exercise 2(ii) to explain the burst of monsoon and identify the highest-rainfall place.
Use Exercise 3(i) to explain climatic unity with regional variation.
